title: Challenging Selectors
description: Random IDs, identical buttons, split text and hidden duplicates that break naïve selectors.

result.title: Last action
result.saved-addresses: Saved delivery address {{deliveryCity}}, {{deliveryPostcode}} and billing address {{billingCity}}, {{billingPostcode}}

random.title: Randomised IDs and classes
random.instructions: The IDs and class names in this form change every time the page loads.
random.label: Display name

rows.title: Identical buttons in every row
rows.instructions: Each row has the same Edit and Delete buttons, and the rows are shuffled on every load.

split.title: Text split across elements
split.instructions: These sentences are made of several elements, so no single element holds the whole text.

addresses.title: Fields told apart by nearby text
addresses.instructions: Both blocks have the same fields, and their labels are not linked to the inputs.

compare.title: Labelled and unlabelled forms
compare.instructions: The same newsletter form twice: once with accessible names and test IDs, once without.

duplicates.title: Hidden duplicates
duplicates.instructions: The Checkout button is in the page more than once, but only one copy is visible at a time.
